About This Book

This comprehensive 656-page catalogue documents the traveling retrospective Felix Gonzalez-Torres: Specific Objects without Specific Form, which showcased work from throughout the artist's career including paintings, sculptures, photographic works, and public projects.

The exhibition employed an innovative format where it was re-installed by a different invited artist midway through its run at each venue, resulting in multiple distinct versions rather than a single definitive presentation. The show deliberately rejected the traditional retrospective model, allowing artists like Carol Bove, Danh Vo, and Tino Sehgal to modify lighting, labels, and the order of presentation.

The exhibition premiered at Wiels in Brussels (January–May 2010) with a version curated by Danh Vo, traveled to Fondation Beyeler in Basel (July–August 2010) with Carol Bove as installation curator, and concluded at Frankfurt's Museum für Moderne Kunst (January–April 2011) with Tino Sehgal. Overall curator: Elena Filipovic.
